title: Single icon set behind semantic aliases
iWant: icons that look like one family and mean one thing each
soThat: iconography aids recognition instead of adding noise

acceptanceCriteria.description: All icons come from the single set selected under ADR-206; no second set or bespoke one-off glyphs appear.
acceptanceCriteria.then: every icon traces to the one declared set

acceptanceCriteria.description: Icons are referenced through the semantic alias registry; components never import glyph files directly.
acceptanceCriteria.then: every reference goes through an alias

acceptanceCriteria.description: The same alias renders the same glyph everywhere; the same meaning never has two competing glyphs.
acceptanceCriteria.given: each alias used in more than one place
acceptanceCriteria.then: glyph use is consistent per meaning

acceptanceCriteria.description: Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology; icons carrying meaning have accessible names; icon-only buttons are labelled.
acceptanceCriteria.then: decorative ones are hidden and meaningful ones named
